mechanisms.note: baroreflex: a rise in arterial pressure slows the heart within 1-2 beats
heart rate -> cardiac output -> arterial pressure
respiratory sinus arrhythmia: inspiration speeds the heart
respiratory modulation of arterial pressure (intrathoracic pressure)
apnea -> desaturation, tens of seconds later (records with SO2 only)

note: cause -> effect pairs from cardiorespiratory physiology; the baroreflex closes within 1-2 beats, the respiratory couplings within a breath
